answer: A concrete defense is orchard tenure with mandatory fallow: each credential holds one plot, and a plot yields only if left unworked for one cycle in three. Yield is keyed to an opal signature issued per plot per harvest, and a relic marker is stamped on any plot worked continuously, zeroing its output until fallow is served. Cloning splits capacity into more plots rather than more yield per plot, so n replicas must idle a third at all times and still pay replanting on each. The schedule is public, so the cost is computable in advance.
